blurb: Key Dives offers scuba diving trips to deep and shallow reefs, advanced wreck dives, snorkeling trips, coral and sponge restoration dives, and scuba certification courses. They provide guided dives with professional dive masters, full gear service, and focus on reef conservation. Their coral restoration dives include training and hands-on coral planting with the I.CARE team.
